capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode, the file, folder and language icon associations of the workspace settings are ignored (they may point to SVG files); the user settings still apply.
configuration.activeIconPacks: Select an icon pack that enables specific icons.
configuration.accentColor: The accent color of Cool Islands Dark and Light, as `#rrggbb` (empty: the blue of the JetBrains Islands themes). It replaces the blue of the focus ring, buttons, progress bar, links, the active tab and the selection; git, terminal and debugger colors are not touched. Wins over the layers of `colorThemeLayers` and loses to `colorThemeByKey`. Reload the window to see it. Works in the desktop app only.
configuration.accentColor.pattern: Use a color like #8bc34a, or leave it empty for the Islands blue
configuration.arrowTheme: Configure the style of arrow icons
configuration.colorThemeByKey: Single colors of another installed color theme, whatever the layers: a workbench color id or a glob of them (`terminal.*`), `scope:<TextMate scope>` (`scope:comment`) or `semantic:<selector>` (`semantic:parameter`) -> id of the theme (as in `workbench.colorTheme`). Wins over everything else.
configuration.colorThemeLayers: Other installed color themes mixed with Cool Islands, the first listed wins. An entry is a theme id (as in `workbench.colorTheme`), or an object with the theme and how it mixes, for the workbench colors and for the syntax colors. A theme mixes into the Cool Islands theme of its own kind (dark or light) unless `applyTo` says otherwise. Reload the window to see the change.
configuration.colorThemeLayers.applyTo: Which Cool Islands theme the layer mixes into. By default, the one of the same kind as the theme.
configuration.colorThemeLayers.mode.fill: Only the colors Cool Islands has none for.
configuration.colorThemeLayers.mode.over: The colors of this theme win (for the syntax: its syntax colors replace the ones of Cool Islands).
configuration.colorThemeLayers.syntax: How the theme mixes for the syntax colors (token and semantic colors).
configuration.colorThemeLayers.theme: Id of an installed color theme, as in `workbench.colorTheme`.
configuration.colorThemeLayers.ui: How the theme mixes for the workbench colors.
configuration.iconThemeByName: File name, `*.ext` or `folder/` -> id of the installed file icon theme giving its icon. Wins over everything else.
configuration.iconThemeLayers: Other installed file icon themes mixed with this theme, the first listed wins. An entry is a theme id (as in `workbench.iconTheme`, e.g. `material-icon-theme`), or an object with that id and how the theme mixes for files and for folders. Empty to use this theme only.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.files: How the theme mixes with this theme for files.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.folders: How the theme mixes with this theme for folders.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.mode.fill: Only for the names no theme above gives an icon to.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.mode.overr: Its icon wins for every name it gives an icon to, and its default icon too. Your own associations still win.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.theme: Id of an installed file icon theme, as in `workbench.iconTheme`.
configuration.folders.color: Change the color of the folder icons.
configuration.folders.theme: Set the type for the folder icons.
configuration.hideFileIcons: Hide the file icons (folder icons are kept).
configuration.monochrome: Display the file and folder icons in a single color (see monochromeColor).
configuration.monochromeColor: Color of the icons when monochrome is enabled.
configuration.opacity: Change the opacity of the icons.
configuration.productIconByName: Icon id or glob of them (`debug-*`) -> id of the installed product icon theme giving its icon (as in `workbench.productIconTheme`). Wins over everything else.
configuration.productIconThemeLayers: Other installed product icon themes mixed with Cool Islands Icons, the first listed wins. An entry is a theme id (as in `workbench.productIconTheme`), or an object with the theme and how it mixes. Reload the window to see the change.
configuration.productIconThemeLayers.mod: How the theme mixes with Cool Islands Icons.
Only the icons Cool Islands Icons has none for (VS Code draws them with its own icons otherwise).
configuration.productIconThemeLayers.the: Id of an installed product icon theme, as in `workbench.productIconTheme`.
configuration.saturation: Change the saturation of the icons.
configuration.showFontMessage: Offer the JetBrains fonts once when a Cool Islands color theme is selected, and suggest installing JetBrains Mono (and D2Coding with a Korean interface) when the editor uses the JetBrains fonts without them.
configuration.showUpdateMessage: Show the update message after each update.
configuration.showWelcomeMessage: Show the welcome message after first installation.
configuration.title: Cool Theme Kit
command.useTheme: Use a Theme of the Kit
walkthrough.colors.description:
The colors of the JetBrains Islands Dark and Islands Light themes, for the workbench and the syntax.
[Use Cool Islands Dark](command:a-file-icon-vscode.useTheme?%5B%22dark%22%5D)
[Use Cool Islands Light](command:a-file-icon-vscode.useTheme?%5B%22light%22%5D)
walkthrough.colors.title: Color theme: Cool Islands
walkthrough.description: Choose the parts of the JetBrains look you want: each one is separate, and none is applied until you choose it.
walkthrough.fonts.description:
JetBrains Mono in the editor and Inter in the Markdown preview, with Korean fonts (D2Coding, Malgun Gothic…) for Hangul. They are written to your user settings only when you choose them.
[Use the JetBrains Fonts](command:a-file-icon-vscode.useJetBrainsFonts)
walkthrough.fonts.title: Fonts: JetBrains Mono
walkthrough.icons.description:
The file and folder icons that PyCharm shows. Choose them alone if you only want the file icons.
[Use Cool Icons](command:a-file-icon-vscode.useTheme?%5B%22icons%22%5D)
Or [choose another file icon theme](command:workbench.action.selectIconTheme).
walkthrough.icons.title: File icons: Cool Icons
walkthrough.mix.description:
VS Code uses one theme of each kind. Mix other installed themes into the kit by priority, with a preview, without editing JSON.
[Mix Themes](command:a-file-icon-vscode.openThemeMixer)
walkthrough.mix.title: Mix in other themes
walkthrough.product.description:
The icons of the JetBrains New UI for the activity bar, the views and the editor actions.
[Use Cool Islands Icons](command:a-file-icon-vscode.useTheme?%5B%22product%22%5D)
walkthrough.product.title: Product icons: Cool Islands Icons
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Cool Theme Kit
